author: mafeis
changelog:
0.1.4
- Settings changed on the plugin settings page now take effect right away: the renderer re-reads them on a short poll and whenever the window regains focus, instead of only once at load
- Turning the composer icon back on, or changing width, no longer needs an app restart
- 中文：设置页的改动现在立刻生效——渲染器会短间隔回读并在窗口重新获得焦点时立即同步，不再只在加载时读一次；重新打开快捷图标或改宽度都不必重启应用
0.1.3
- New setting showTrigger: turn the composer shortcut icon off and on from the plugin settings page
- Hiding the icon closes the panel it anchors, and leaves the toolbar untouched
- The layout override keeps working either way
0.1.2
- The composer button lost its border and background, so only the icon is left; the icon went from 14 to 18 px
- The icon is now a solid glyph (content block plus solid arrows) that stays readable at toolbar size
0.1.1
- The composer button is now a plain layout icon: a content container with arrows pointing out to the side gutters, no number on it
- The current width, and any sidebar bonus, moved into the button's tooltip
0.1.0
- Control the conversation content width from the composer toolbar: presets 760 / 960 / 1200 / 1440 / full width, or any value between 640 and 2400
- Adjustable side gutters between 8 and 56 px
- Follows the sidebar: widen automatically while the sidebar is collapsed
- Respects the native width drag handles and adopts the width you drag out
- Panel shows the measured width of the real transcript column

description: Control the conversation layout: content width (presets, custom, full-width) and side gutters, adjustable from a composer toolbar button; the choice is saved with the plugin.

en.name: Layout Control
en.description: Control the conversation layout: content width (presets, custom, full-width) and side gutters, adjustable from a composer toolbar button; the choice is saved with the plugin.
en.safetyNotes: Only writes one style element and CSS custom properties on the host document root, and reads the app shell's sidebar class and width to keep the adjustment in step. renderer.extension is flagged high risk because the extension runs in the host document; this plugin does not read transcript or draft text, does not use internal IPC, sends nothing off the device and registers no agent tools.

zh-CN.name: 布局控制
zh-CN.description: 控制会话界面布局：会话内容宽度（预设 / 自定义 / 满宽，含左右留白），在输入框工具栏一键调节，设置随插件保存。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只在宿主文档根节点上写入一个 style 元素和 CSS 自定义属性，并读取应用外壳的侧栏类名与宽度以同步加宽。renderer.extension 因运行在宿主文档中被标为高风险；本插件不读取消息或输入框正文、不使用内部 IPC、不联网、不注册 Agent 工具。
